name: – Dimitris Tsiodras, Piotr Müller – Article 2, § 1, point 2, point a, point i – Am 117
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EC) No 1272/2008, (EC) No 1223/2009 and (EU) 2019/1009 as regards simplification of certain requirements and procedures for chemical products
section: Article 2 – paragraph 1 – point 2 – point a – point i a (new)
part_text: (i a) The first subparagraph is replaced by the following: 2. The use in cosmetic products of substances classified as CMR substances, of category 1A or 1B, or as endocrine disruptors for human health, of category 1 or 2, under Part 3 of Annex VI to Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008 shall be prohibited.
